| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Noise sigma** `sigma` | 0 | 0 to 100 levels | The standard deviation of the noise. 0 estimates it with scikit-image's estimate_sigma, our choice. |
| **Output** `output` | Final (after Wiener) | Final (after Wiener), Basic (after hard threshold) | The final estimate, or the basic estimate of the first step. |
| **Search radius** `searchRadius` | 19 | 4 to 19 px | Similar patches are searched in a window of 2 radius + 1 pixels. 19 gives the 39 x 39 window of Lebrun's study. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Each channel separately, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
